tools.name: room
tools.description: Orientation. The service, your key, the scopes of the room by name, the issues and changes the directory lists (50 a page), the standalone scopes, your standing on each membership, the active definitions, and the act tools your role does not hold. Start here.

tools.name: inspect
tools.description: One scope: its definition and digest, status, head, counts by item type and state, and its live items, paged by bytes at its head. With declaration: true, the definition's bytes, paged. With describe: <kind>, the complete derived text of one act, for an act whose tool description points here.

scope.description: A scope ID; one of register, directory, membership, rules, destination, inbox; or an issue or change number.

tools.name: create
tools.description: Creates a scope with no existing target, and records it in your configuration so later connections list its tools. definition: a platform name such as platform:register@3, a definition's JSON, or its digest; kind: the definition's genesis act; fields; texts and definitions beside it; membership: the membership scope standing for the new scope is read from. Kept under custody like an act: the idempotencyKey is required.

idempotencyKey.description: Your key for this one meaning, 1 to 128 bytes. Keep it.

answer.description: accepted, refused, unavailable, mismatch, or unknown when the reply was lost

retained.description: true when this is a terminal outcome kept under custody, and nothing was sent

tools.name: join
tools.description: Joins a room with an invitation link from artroom invite (artroom-invite:...), as artroom join does: signs membership's join with this server's key, keeps the exact request under custody before sending it, and on acceptance records the room in your configuration, so its tools are listed. After a lost reply, call again with the same link and idempotencyKey: the same request is sent again, never a new one. The link holds the invitation's secret, which no result repeats.

idempotencyKey.description: Your key for this one meaning, 1 to 128 bytes. Keep it.

answer.description: accepted, refused, unavailable, mismatch, or unknown when the reply was lost

retained.description: true when this is a terminal outcome kept under custody, and nothing was sent

tools.name: prepare
tools.description: Asks the scope that owns a resource for one step of a capability, for the intent an act will submit later under the same idempotencyKey. resource: the scope asked, which may differ from target; capability, step; then the act's own target, kind, on, fields, texts, presented and values. Returns the resource's answer for that step, never the act's receipt.

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Waits at most 60 seconds until one of: a scope's head reaches seq; an item reaches one of states; the scopes an entry created (entry) and the scopes their genesis created exist and are active; a send (duty) has a result. Returns what it saw and whether it timed out. Never writes.

tools.name: settle
tools.description: What is known about the envelope under idempotencyKey on target (or the creation of definition): the act's phase and kept outcome, the scope's settlement for an act that is not final, and each preparation step apart. Signs nothing and sends no act.
